newsitem.title: LITHUANIA: VILNIAUS BANK STICKS TO PROFIT FORECAST.
newsitem.headline: VILNIAUS BANK STICKS TO PROFIT FORECAST.

text.p: Lithuania's Vilniaus Bank said on Monday that it saw no need to change its profit forecast of 39 million litas for 1997.
"We are working according to our schedule and the profit forecast will not be changed for 1997," the bank's chairman, Julius Niedaras, told a news conference.
The bank said earlier that its unadudited net profit for the first six months of the year was 21.4 million litas compared to 11.7 million litas in the same period last year.
Its total 1996 profit was 24.4 million litas.
